what: PORYGON2 v3 harness bars and the step-C student's pass rule, written BEFORE any net was scored on the frozen evaluation set (solver/porygon2/v3/DESIGN.md §1)
evalset: solver/out/p2v3/evalset (solver/porygon2/v3/evalset.js build, release eaa5becc54eb); its sha256 is in its manifest and in every report

reference.what: MILTANK's root (gen5 MAG+DODUO ranking, k1 = k2 = 4, one reserved switch row, the mega reservation) on honest worlds, each cell filled by games played to the END by gen5's prior argmax on both sides; no value net in it (solver/porygon2/v3/deep.js)
reference.noise_ceiling: the reference against itself, even vs odd playouts, reported beside every ranking figure

ranking: Kendall tau-b of the net's row values against the deep row values, both under the deep column mix (SLOWKING LP on the deep matrix)
top-1: the net's best row is the deep best row
regret: deep best row value minus the deep value of the net's own LP row mix (win-probability points)
cell tau-b over all k x k cells
calibration: log-loss, Brier, ECE (10 equal-width bins) against the game result, by source and by min-rating band
gap[0.5,0.9): mean value minus win rate over positions valued in [0.5, 0.9) (the ladder postmortem's +0.19 window), game-clustered bootstrap CI
metrics.cost: microseconds per leaf evaluation (encode + forward), every net interleaved round-robin on the same successor boards in one process (evalset.js bench); the ratio to gen5's net is the figure, the absolute is load-dependent

intervals: paired against gen5's net, bootstrap over games, 2,000 resamples (ECE and |gap| 400), seed 7, 95%

student_pass_rule.net: the step-C student (solver/porygon2/v3/student.py, distilled from PORYGON2 v2 k1)
pass_iff_all: ranking: paired delta tau-b > 0 with the 95% CI lower bound > 0, OR paired delta regret < 0 with the CI upper bound < 0; and the point estimate of delta top-1 is >= 0
calibration: paired delta ECE <= 0 (point) with the CI upper bound < +0.005, and |gap[0.5,0.9)| no larger than gen5's (point)
cost: median leaf cost ratio to gen5 <= 1.00 in the same bench run
student_pass_rule.on_pass: pre-register (not run) the 14 s not-lose screen (200 games, the same 100 TEST pairs, pair seed 1, role-v1) and then an SPRT; on fail, neither is pre-registered
student_pass_rule.read: once, from the first complete report over the labelled set; no re-scoring to chase the bar

answer_map.what: Will's live answer map (2026-10-01), solver/porygon2/v3/answer_map.js: P(i beats j) for every live pair from MEDICHAM's facts on the current board, aggregated per side
answer_map.cost: median microseconds per evaluation on the same boards as the bench, cold memo and warm (successors of one root)
answer_map.effect: information beyond a net, measured without training on the evaluation set: a logistic recalibration of the net's logit fitted on bo3 VAL positions (not in the set) WITH the 12 answer-map aggregates, against the same recalibration WITHOUT them (the control), both applied to the frozen set; reported as delta log-loss, ECE, gap and ranking metrics with paired CIs. No bar: it decides whether the map goes into the v3 teacher's inputs, not into any arm
